title: How Much is a Dragon Bishop Worth?
summary: Explainer Short: the Dragon Bishop moves like a bishop or a knight (bishop+knight compound; slides can't jump). Valued by squares controlled (~21 from centre) at about 7 points; it can checkmate a lone king on its own (shown mating a cornered king with a pawn's help in one diagram).
rules: Dragon Bishop: moves/captures as bishop OR knight.
